codes.name: NOWA
codes.description: Norwegian Overnight Weighted Average. Weighted average of interest rates set in agreements concluded by banks for unsecured loans in NOK, where the loan is paid out on the same day and repayment occurs on the following banking day.

descriptions.en: Norwegian Overnight Weighted Average. Weighted average of interest rates set in agreements concluded by banks for unsecured loans in NOK, where the loan is paid out on the same day and repayment occurs on the following banking day.
